scope: Repeat the existing source-free background covariance diagnostic across geometry-only splits. No galaxy emission, gravity prediction or target motion residual is scored.
trigger: The original checkerboard and balanced splits assigned a residual channel-correlation failure to different galaxies. A single selected split cannot establish covariance robustness.
reverse_definition: Swap complete guarded block interiors between calibration and validation; then apply the original stride only to validation. Keep the original annulus and every numerical gate.
replicate_identity: Hash both actual calibration and validation masks; duplicated partitions are flagged and counted only once in per-galaxy robustness summaries.
summary_rule: Report the range of every metric and failed gates across all unique declared partitions. A split-stable pass requires all those partitions to pass; this is a descriptive robustness flag, not a calibrated statistical test or an exclusion based on gravity performance.
limitations: These partitions reuse the same background realization and are correlated; failure fractions are not independent probabilities or p-values.
The conditional six-lag channel and Gaussian spatial covariance forms are unchanged; a failure may reflect form, stationarity, residual emission or finite sample uncertainty.
No exact Gaussianity, separability, inner-galaxy noise transfer or valid galaxy selection mask is established.
The full cube packet is read for its background values; galaxy-region values are zeroed before the diagnostic and no fitted velocity or source amplitude fields are loaded.
